label: chromium__canvas-trigger-badge-popover
description: KNOWN a11y limitation, not fixable in app code (LE-2235). The two <span tabindex="0" data-radix-focus-guard> elements are injected at the <body> edges by Radix's focus guards while the trigger badge Popover is open, so IBM reports element_tabbable_role_valid on them. Same limitation as chromium__model-picker-popover-open-non-first-selected: they are invisible, contentless focus sentinels that disappear when the popover closes. Only these two guards are baselined; any other violation in the popover still fails tests/a11y/triggers.a11y.spec.ts ('badge popover opens from the keyboard, names the state and returns focus').
